what_it_sells: Leadfeeder identifies the B2B companies behind anonymous website visits, scores them against an ideal customer profile and buying intent signals, enriches them with company and contact data from a database of 60 million companies, and pushes them to Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho, Slack, Google Ads, Mailchimp and 5,000+ apps through Zapier. There is a free Lite plan and paid plans from 79 euros per month, plus Workflows automation, an MCP server and B2B display campaigns.
customers: B2B marketing and sales teams; the pages claim 15,000+ companies and address marketers, sales reps, account-based marketing teams and, through APIs, marketplaces, publishers and ad platforms.
problems_solved: most website visitors never fill in a form; no visibility into which companies are researching the business; generic outreach that prospects ignore; manual lead routing, list refreshing and CRM updates; ad budget spent on companies that do not fit; time lost researching companies and contacts
use_cases_explicit: Identifying up to 45% of companies visiting the website; Scoring visitors against the ideal customer profile and 40+ buying intent signals; Automatic lead scoring from web activity with alerts when target accounts visit; Workflows that route leads, refresh lists, update the CRM and alert reps; Slack alerts the moment an identified company visits; Seeing which Google Ads campaigns and keywords bring the right companies; AI summaries of what a visitor did and whether a company fits the ICP; Asking in Claude or ChatGPT which good-fit companies visited this week
use_cases_interpreted: Show a B2B services firm which local companies looked at its pricing page this week.; Alert the owner in Slack when a target account comes back to the site.; Create a HubSpot deal automatically when a high-fit company visits twice.; Cut Google Ads spend by seeing which keywords bring real companies rather than clicks.; Give a one-person sales effort a ranked list of companies to call on Monday.
small_business_fit: partly, there is a free Lite plan and a 79 euro Discover plan that a small B2B firm can use, but it only works for companies selling to other businesses with enough website traffic, and pricing is in euros.
site_framing: The consultancy's leadfeeder.ts files Leadfeeder under marketing, lead-capture-pipeline/lead-enrichment-and-predictive-scoring, as a way to uncover which local companies visit a small business's website and score their buying intent so every sales and marketing hour counts.

name: Lightyear
what_it_sells: Lightyear is cloud accounts payable automation that captures supplier bills by email or mobile app, extracts line item data with AI, applies coding rules, routes bills and purchase orders through up to eight approval levels, 3-way matches POs, goods received notes and invoices, reconciles supplier statements, handles employee expenses and syncs to Xero, Sage, NetSuite, MYOB and inventory systems. Plans run on monthly document credits from $199 per month with unlimited users and entities and a 30-day free trial.
customers: Finance teams at small and mid-sized businesses, plus accountants and bookkeepers who deploy it for clients; industry pages cover hospitality, construction, education and independent schools, aged care and retail, and the company reports 20,000+ users across 40+ countries from offices in Belfast and Sydney.
problems_solved: manual keying of supplier invoices; approvals stuck in email inboxes; paying against the wrong order or paying twice; month-end supplier statement reconciliation; no visibility of spend before it happens; paper receipts and expense claims to chase
use_cases_explicit: Smart Extract+ AI line item extraction of product codes, prices, tax rates and quantities; Rule-based GL, tax and tracking category coding at supplier, bill, line or product level; Multi-tier approval workflows with notifications and one-click approval on mobile; Purchase orders raised, approved and sent to suppliers from the app; 3-way matching of PO, goods received note and invoice at line level with discrepancy flags; Automatic supplier statement reconciliation that flags missing invoices; Automated price checking against PO or agreed supplier pricing; Expense capture from phone receipts with duplicate flagging and reimbursement reports
use_cases_interpreted: Let a restaurant group email all supplier bills to one address and have them coded and queued for approval.; Give a construction project manager a phone app to raise POs and approve invoices from site.; Stop a retailer overpaying by checking invoice prices against the agreed supplier list.; Clear a bookkeeper's month-end backlog by matching supplier statements automatically.; Replace paper expense claims with photo capture and a single approval queue.
small_business_fit: partly, it is built for small and mid-sized finance teams with unlimited users and a $199 entry plan, but the credit pricing suits businesses with a steady bill volume, and the company is UK and Australia based with US pricing on a regional tab.
site_framing: no tool file

name: LiveFlow
what_it_sells: LiveFlow sells two products: Flow, an agentic accounting platform that replaces the general ledger and uses AI agents to reconcile bank feeds continuously, capture and code bills, invoice and chase receivables, eliminate intercompany entries and close the books across many entities; and LiveFlow FP&A, which consolidates, reports, dashboards and budgets on top of an existing ERP such as QuickBooks Online or Xero, with live models in Google Sheets and Excel. Pricing is tailored and sold through a demo.
customers: Multi-entity and physical businesses that have outgrown their accounting software: franchises and restaurant groups, construction contractors, healthcare operators, private equity portfolios, technology companies, dioceses and nonprofits, with case studies from a 25-company roll-up and a construction group.
problems_solved: month-end close that takes ten days; reconciliation done in one painful batch; bills keyed by hand and approvals chased; overdue invoices nobody is chasing; manual consolidation and intercompany eliminations across entities; WIP and job costing rebuilt in spreadsheets every month
use_cases_explicit: AI agents that match and code bank transactions as they clear so only exceptions need review; Bills captured, scanned, coded to the right entity and routed for approval with a senior accountant reviewing; Contracts turned into invoices with reminders that escalate until paid; Intercompany transactions eliminated at the source with no month-end elimination entries; One-click consolidation across entities in 160+ currencies; Budget versus actuals with department-level approval flows in FinanceIQ; Live WIP, job costing and cash flow forecasting from Procore, Buildertrend and JobTread data; QuickBooks history migrated in an afternoon and Sheets or Excel models that update automatically
use_cases_interpreted: Give a three-location restaurant group one consolidated P&L with food and labor percentages per store.; Let a contractor see job margin slipping while the job is still open instead of months later.; Keep a growing clinic group's books reconciled every day so the owner always knows cash.; Send and chase customer invoices automatically for a services firm with a part-time bookkeeper.; Replace a monthly spreadsheet report pack for an investor or lender with a live dashboard.
small_business_fit: partly, the FP&A product works on top of QuickBooks Online or Xero for a growing business, but the pages lead with multi-entity finance teams, companies that have outgrown their accounting software and demo-only pricing, which is beyond a single-location small business.
site_framing: no tool file

name: LivePlan

Once the business is running it syncs with QuickBooks Online or Xero for budget versus actuals, cash flow forecasts, scenarios and an AI monthly review, from $15 per month billed annually with a 35-day money-back guarantee.
customers: Entrepreneurs and small business owners starting, funding or growing a business, with the pages claiming over 1.5 million businesses served, plus business consultants and coaches, educators, SBA partners such as SBDCs, CPAs offering advisory services, incubators and small business lenders.
problems_solved: not knowing if an idea is worth pursuing; market research that takes days or costs thousands; a plan whose narrative and numbers do not agree; forecasts built in fragile spreadsheets; cash squeezes that arrive without warning; monthly reports nobody has time to build

use_cases_interpreted: Prepare an SBA loan application for a new restaurant with sourced market data and lender-ready statements.; Test whether adding a second crew pays off for a landscaping company before hiring.; Give a barbershop owner a one-page plan and milestones instead of handwritten notes.; Turn QuickBooks data into a monthly budget versus actual report the owner can read in minutes.; Let an accountant deliver forecasting advice to small clients from one shared model.
small_business_fit: yes, the pages say it is trusted by over a million small business owners, it starts at $15 per month, needs no finance background and syncs with QuickBooks Online and Xero.
site_framing: no tool file

name: LobbyStack

problems_solved: missed calls while the crew is on a job; callers who hang up on voicemail and phone the next company; after-hours emergencies going unanswered; manual scheduling and callback ping-pong; human answering services that get expensive; spam and vendor calls interrupting the day

use_cases_interpreted: Let a plumber's phone be answered and jobs booked while the owner is under a sink.; Route a 10 pm no-heat call to the on-call technician and log everything else for the morning.; Book dental cleanings and handle reschedules without a front desk hire.; Give a salon's clients booking by phone while every stylist is with a client.; Put a dollar figure on missed calls to decide whether an answering service pays for itself.
small_business_fit: yes, every page addresses small businesses, trades and local service firms by name, with a free plan, paid plans from $24 per month and setup on the existing business number.
site_framing: The consultancy's lobbystack.ts files LobbyStack under marketing, lead-capture-pipeline/intelligent-receptionist, as a customizable Intelligent Receptionist that stops small businesses missing calls without a full-time receptionist or a closed platform.

name: Lusha

customers: Go-to-market, sales and marketing teams at companies of any size, with the pages claiming 280,000+ revenue teams; integration pages note Pipedrive and Zoho are popular with small and mid-sized sales teams.
problems_solved: stale or missing emails and phone numbers in the CRM; hours of manual prospect research; inbound leads routed without company context; not knowing which accounts are in market; duplicate records when exporting to the CRM; high entry cost and setup of enterprise data tools

site_framing: The consultancy's lusha.ts files Lusha under marketing, lead-capture-pipeline/lead-enrichment-and-predictive-scoring, as a way to identify and engage real decision-makers by enriching lead data and scoring prospects, turning anonymous visits and stale lists into real conversations.
